## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2020-07-06: S-1/A files the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.1 (preamble date "July [...], 2020"; unsigned)
- 2020-07-15: Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed between GoHealth, Inc., GoHealth Holdings, LLC, and the TRA Holders
- 2020-07-17: 8-K Item 1.01 attaches the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.1

## Explanation

GoHealth's TRA originated at its July 15, 2020 Up-C IPO, obligating the public company to pay 85% of realized tax benefits to the Continuing Equity Owners and Blocker Shareholders. Covered attributes are Section 754 basis step-ups from exchanges of GoHealth Holdings, LLC interests for Class A stock, pre-IPO tax attributes inherited from the Blocker entities, and gross-up deductions on TRA payments themselves. The contract has not been amended, restated, or terminated through the fiscal-2025 10-K; the September 2022 Centerbridge-led Series A preferred investment and the August 2025 superpriority senior secured credit facility signal financial pressure but do not touch the TRA. The recorded liability has grown gradually from $0 in 2020-2021 to $1.3M at year-end 2025; no payments have yet been made. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
